biological_replicate: The collection and preparation of pistil, three DAP and seven DAP seeds of Nipponbare were performed as described previously with three biological replicates.
experimental_design: inferred: a quantitative, MS-based acetylproteomic study for the seeds at three typical developing stages, namely unpollinated pistil (S0), seed at three DAP (Day After Pollination) (S3) and seven DAP (S7) of Nipponbare (Oryza sativa L. ssp japonica) with three biological replicates
factor_value: The three time points represent the pre-pollination, post-pollination, fast proliferation and histodifferentiation status of rice seed.
number_of_biological_replicates: The collection and preparation of pistil, three DAP and seven DAP seeds of Nipponbare were performed as described previously with three biological replicates.
number_of_samples: The collection and preparation of pistil, three DAP and seven DAP seeds of Nipponbare were performed as described previously with three biological replicates.
technology_type: A quantitative acetylomic analysis of early seed development in Rice (Oryza sativa L.) by employing a mass spectral-based (MS-based), label-free approach.
